name: item_totals
summary: Total quantity of each item type in the world, split into on_ground, carried, stored, machine_stock and silo, with the holders holding most. Same filters as find_items, area, exact prefab and prefabs included. 12 types by default. Read only.

help.text: Answers 'how much iron ingot do I have and where'. quantity includes machine stock (a furnace's or centrifuge's load gets its own row with prefab_name null and reagent set); item_count counts items only, machine_stock_entries the machine and reagent pairs, silo_entries the things silos store (entries and their contents). top_holders lists holders_limit holders per type (default 1, 0 leaves it out), each with kind (player, stored, machine_stock or silo) and position.
help.keys: totals [{prefab_name, display_name, items, quantity, on_ground, carried, stored, machine_stock, silo, ...}], prefab_count, item_count, machine_stock_entries, silo_entries.

prefab.description: The whole prefab name, any case, as place_structure and describe_prefab take it ('StructureFrame' is not 'StructureFrameCorner'); with prefab_contains both must match.

prefab_contains.description: Part of the prefab name, any case ('IngotIron', 'Ore', 'Battery').

name_contains.description: Part of the shown name, any case ('Iron Ingot').

location.description: ground, player, stored, machine_stock or silo; default any (see items).

within_id.description: Only items inside this thing at any depth, and its machine stock or silo store.

min.description: Box corner, [x, y, z] m; with max: only items whose outermost holder (a machine's stock: the machine) stands in the box.

near.description: A point, [x, y, z] m; with radius_m: only items whose outermost holder is within radius_m of it.

near_player_m.description: Only things whose outermost holder is within this many metres of the player.

holders_limit.description: Holders per type in top_holders, most first; default 1, 0 for none.
